venues.name: The Avenue (central hub)
venues.notes: Central evening hub; dining bars run live music in parallel.

entertainmentProgram: Entertainment concentrates in the evening: dining bars and the central Avenue hub run live music in parallel from ~6pm, a produced show in the Central Atrium rotates nightly, and a late-night DJ anchors the Red Bar past midnight. Daytime carries far less programmed entertainment.
dayNightFlow: Thin daytime entertainment; dense evening from ~6pm; late-night DJ at the Red Bar.
